content: The execution successfully completed the HWPX (ZIP-based XML) transformation. Key successes include: 1) Using regex to handle placeholders that the HWPX editor frequently splits across multiple <hp:t> tags. 2) Correctly calculating project duration (months) from date strings within the XML. 3) Crucially, removing <hp:lineSegArray> elements from modified paragraphs, which prevents rendering artifacts in HWP/Hancom Office. The strategy of using string/regex manipulation instead of a formal XML parser was effective for preserving the specific structure required by HWPX.
